title: Diagnose
intro: Phase 1: understand the current state with evidence, find root causes and size the value at stake.

t01.title: Current-State Diagnostic (T01)
t01.intro: One row for each of the six diagnostic dimensions: current state, evidence or baseline, root cause, impact (in money or on a KPI) and confidence.
t01.impactCurrencyHint: Required when an amount is entered.

workstreams.title: Diagnose workstreams
workstreams.intro: The six workstreams with their key questions. Record findings (symptoms, root causes, opportunities, observations) and the outputs each workstream produced.

finding.statusHint: A finding is a draft until it is confirmed. Only confirmed root-cause findings count for G1.
finding.caption: Findings of {{workstream}}
